predictive_services_discussion: Critical fire weather conditions will revolve around scattered thunderstorms today across portions of southern Oregon, northern California, northern Nevada, and southern Idaho. These thunderstorms will be a mix of wet and dry, however considerable cloud-to-ground lightning is anticipated. The lightning threat will likely continue into the overnight hours. The other area of concern today will occur over the Great Basin due to the combination of gusty winds, dry relative humidity values and hot temperatures. Across the eastern 2/3rds of the county expect cooler temperatures with higher relative humidity values due to the passage of a cold front. The only area with moderate risk of significant fire potential will occur over southern Florida due to relatively dry conditions with the threat of thunderstorms. Over Alaska look for the warming and drying trend to continue with moderate risk of significant fires over eastern portions of the state.
